title: Spin Versus Pace: Mapping Punjab Kings’s Batting Trade-Offs
dek: Do Punjab Kings score more freely against pace or spin, and what does each cost them in wickets? Bowling-type data since 2022 maps the trade-off.
excerpt: Compared with the rest of the league, Punjab Kings' batting has been relatively weaker against spin since 2022. That shapes how opponents will bowl at them.
author: CricField Editorial Desk
keyTakeaways: PBKS struck at {{ev:svp-team-pace-sr}} against pace and {{ev:svp-team-spin-sr}} against spin (2022–2026).
The rest of the IPL struck at {{ev:svp-rest-pace-sr}} and {{ev:svp-rest-spin-sr}} respectively.
Bowling type is known for {{ev:svp-cov}} of deliveries in the window.

sections.heading: Two Different Games
body: Batting against pace and batting against spin reward different skills: one punishes the ball that is too full or too short, the other the ball that is flighted or too flat. Every side has a lean, and opposition analysts look for it first.
CricField attached each bowler's type from player-bio data to every delivery since 2022. Bowling type is known for {{ev:svp-cov}} of balls.

sections.heading: Punjab Kings' Lean
body: Against pace, Punjab Kings struck at {{ev:svp-team-pace-sr}} and lost a wicket every {{ev:svp-team-pace-bpd}} balls. Against spin they struck at {{ev:svp-team-spin-sr}}, losing a wicket every {{ev:svp-team-spin-bpd}} balls.

The league comparison matters because everyone scores at different rates against the two types: the rest of the IPL struck at {{ev:svp-rest-pace-sr}} against pace and {{ev:svp-rest-spin-sr}} against spin. Relative to that baseline, PBKS are weaker against spin.

sections.heading: How Opponents Will Plan
body: A relative weakness against spin invites more of it: opposition captains will hold their spinners for the middle overs.
The counter is in selection and order: a batter who is strong against spin should be placed where that bowling is most likely to come.

sections.heading: Type Is Not Everything
body: Pace and spin are broad labels. A left-arm wrist spinner and an off-spinner pose different problems, as do a swing bowler and a hit-the-deck quick. The comparison here also excludes bowlers whose type is unknown.

sections.heading: CricField Verdict: Shore Up Against Spin
body: Punjab Kings should expect to see more spin than average, and should recruit or promote batters who score freely against it.
Tracking strike rate and balls per dismissal by bowling type each season would show whether the gap is closing.
